groups.rationale: Reviewed Access.Pin ownership in the regenerated inventory, unchanged physical host placement, combined Alma guest-local repair and completed Windows signed substitution custody; fresh image journeys and merged-source gates remain separate.

Reviewed removal of redundant trailing blank lines in the two Covenant obligation documents; all obligation IDs, prose, scopes and executable requirements are unchanged, so the already reviewed pin and guest handbook evidence needs no further chapter edit.
Reviewed pin and unpin as validated nonphysical mutations and closed refusal reasons; native image admission and capability authority are unchanged, and both consumers require final-source checks.

Reviewed unchanged Lilly source and host execution boundaries against new shared protocol commands; combined lifecycle and guest artifact evidence adds no host privilege or physical proof and requires final consumer validation.

Reviewed Porsche closed pin reasons, fixed hints and nonphysical dispatch without transport-authority changes; source-selected Windows custody follows independent signed full-content substitution and does not establish guest execution.

Reviewed exact Windows selector name, recursive hash and manifest against independent signed full-content substitution; refreshed declaration probes for both boot receipts and live sshd without changing fallback or readiness authority. Alma guest-local resolver and host placement are preserved; fresh guest journeys remain pending.

Reviewed ADR-0193 accepted/partial, corrected durable-pin versus revoked-grant wording, updated architecture overview and integrated scenarios; imported test reports do not verify merged source, and ADR-0171/0190 scopes remain explicit.
